parents.title: Families
parents.description: {count, plural, =0 {No parents} one {# parent} other {# parents}}
parents.empty_body: Add a parent or import a CSV file to create families.
parents.no_results_body: No parent matches this search or filter.

parent_form.email_hint: The invitation and notifications are sent to this address.
parent_form.email_change_warning: Changing the email signs the parent out and cancels pending invitation links.
parent_form.send_invitation_hint: The parent receives a link valid for 72 hours to choose a password.

access_body.active: The parent has chosen a password and can sign in.
access_body.invited: An invitation was sent; the parent has not chosen a password yet.
access_body.expired: The last invitation expired or was cancelled. Send it again to give access.
access_body.not_invited: The parent has not received an invitation yet.
access_body.inactive: The account is deactivated: the parent can no longer sign in.
access_body.pending: This parent signed up with the QR code. Check their details, then activate or refuse the account.
access_body.refused: Sign-up refused: the account stays deactivated. You can still activate it.

parent_show.whatsapp_no_phone: Add a valid phone number to invite on WhatsApp.
parent_show.whatsapp_ready_body: WhatsApp opens with the message and the link. Press Send to pass it to the parent. This link is personal: do not share it with anyone else.
parent_show.resend_hint: The previous link will stop working.
parent_show.deactivate_body: {name} will no longer be able to sign in and their current sessions will end. Their children and history are kept.
parent_show.activate_body: {name} will be able to sign in again.
parent_show.no_children_body: Add this parent's children so they can order their meals.
parent_show.approve_body: {name} will sign in with the password chosen at sign-up. Their children will be activated.
parent_show.refuse_body: {name}’s account will stay deactivated (it is not deleted).
parent_show.send_codes_hint: Opens WhatsApp with a ready message: the sign-in address and each child’s kiosk code.
parent_show.send_codes_no_phone: No valid WhatsApp number for this parent.

child_form.allergies_hint: Dishes containing one of these allergens cannot be chosen for this child.
child_form.dietary_notes_hint: Optional. Shown on the kitchen's allergy sheet.
child_form.is_active_hint: An inactive child can no longer receive meals.
child_form.delete_body: {name} and their subscription periods will be permanently deleted. To keep the history, deactivate the child instead.
child_form.pin_hint: The code the child types on the school screen to order (the parent sees it too).

subscriptions.title: Subscription periods
subscriptions.description: Subscription meals can only be ordered during an active period. Periods cannot overlap.
subscriptions.delete_body: The subscription period will be deleted.
subscriptions.empty_body: This child has no subscription yet.
subscriptions.end_hint: Leave empty for an open-ended subscription.

import.title: Import families
import.instructions: One row per child. Rows with the same parent email are grouped under one parent. Re-importing the same file creates no duplicates: parents are matched by email, children by parent + first name + last name.
import.date_format: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. parent_locale: fr or en (fr by default).
import.allergies_note: An import never removes an allergy: it only adds them.
import.preview_body: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.has_errors: Fix the errors in the file and import it again. No row is saved while errors remain.
import.nothing_to_do: Every row is already up to date.
import.send_invitations: Send the invitation to new parents
import.send_invitations_hint: {count, plural, =0 {No new parents.} one {# email will be sent.} other {# emails will be sent.}}
import.expired: This preview has expired. Please upload the file again.
import.no_longer_valid: The data changed since the preview: check the errors before confirming.
import.done: Import complete: {createdParents} parent(s) created, {updatedParents} updated, {createdChildren} child(ren) created, {updatedChildren} updated, {createdSubscriptions} period(s) created, {invited} invitation(s) sent.
import.invitation_failures: {count, plural, one {# invitation could not be sent} other {# invitations could not be sent}}. Resend them from the parent's record.

errors.invalid_csv: The file is not a valid CSV (line {line}).
errors.no_rows: The file has no data rows.
errors.too_many_rows: The file has more than {max} rows.
errors.parent_mismatch: Same email as row {line} but a different name, phone or language.
errors.duplicate_child: This child already appears on row {line}.
errors.email_unavailable: parent_email: this address is already used by another account.
errors.email_registration: parent_email: this address belongs to a QR sign-up that is pending or refused. Review it in Families › To activate.

errors.not_a_parent: This account is not a parent account.
errors.no_whatsapp_number: This parent has no valid WhatsApp number.
errors.invite_inactive: Reactivate the account before sending an invitation.
errors.already_has_access: This parent already chose a password. They can use "Forgot password".
errors.invitation_email_failed: The invitation email could not be sent. Please try again later.
errors.subscription_end_before_start: The end must be on or after the start.
errors.subscription_overlap: This period overlaps an existing period ({start} → {end}).
errors.subscription_overlap_generic: This period overlaps an existing period.
errors.child_duplicate: This parent already has a child with this first and last name.
errors.child_has_orders: This child has orders: deactivate them instead of deleting.
errors.no_free_pin: Could not assign a kiosk code: try again.
errors.pin_conflict: This kiosk code was just given to another child: try again.

flash.parent_deactivated: Account deactivated. Current sessions are closed.
flash.invitation_resent: New invitation sent to {email}. The old link no longer works.
flash.registration_approved: Account activated. Now send the codes on WhatsApp.
flash.registration_refused: Sign-up refused: the account stays deactivated.
flash.registration_email_confirmed: Email confirmed by staff: you can now activate the account.

registration.title: Create your account
registration.subtitle: Sign your children up for meals at {school}. The school will approve your account.
registration.phone_hint: We will send your codes on WhatsApp, e.g. +212 6 12 34 56 78.
registration.sent_body: Your request is saved. Open the email we just sent you and confirm your address. The school will then activate your account and send your children’s kiosk codes on WhatsApp. If this address already has an account, no email is sent: just sign in.
registration.too_many: Too many requests from this connection. Try again in {minutes} min.

errors.not_pending: This sign-up has already been reviewed.
errors.email_not_confirmed: The parent must confirm their email first.
errors.not_unconfirmed: This sign-up is no longer waiting for an email confirmation.

registration.list_empty_body: Parents who sign up with the QR code appear here.

confirm.title: Confirm your email address
confirm.body: Press the button to confirm this address is yours.
confirm.done_body: Thank you! Your request now waits for the school’s approval. You will get your children’s kiosk codes on WhatsApp.
confirm.invalid_body: This link was already used or is no longer valid. Contact the school if your account is not active yet.
confirm.name: Name
confirm.not_me_hint: If you did not make this request, press “This wasn’t me”: it will be refused.
confirm.declined_body: Thank you. This request will not be activated and your address will not be used.

registration.review_hint: Before activating: check the children are enrolled at the school under these names and the email is confirmed.
registration.confirm_email_body: Only do this if you checked that {email} really belongs to {name} (by phone, on WhatsApp or in person). Your name is recorded.
registration.whatsapp_confirmation_ready_body: WhatsApp opens with the message and the confirmation link. Press Send to pass it to the parent. The previous link no longer works.

client.password: The password does not follow the rules below.

registration.review_step_hint: Check your details before sending the request. You can still change them.
